title: RumVitalWebsocketClosingEvent
description: Schema for the vital reported when a WebSocket connection starts closing. Reported at most once per connection. Reported with vital.name websocket_closing

closing_date.description: Date the connection was asked to close, in ms from epoch. Computed from the connecting date and the time elapsed since, measured on a monotonic clock

close_initiator.description: Side that initiated the close. Always client on this vital, since it is only reported when the application calls close(). The websocket_closed vital reports the initiator of every connection, server and unknown included
